answer: Because the zephyr stake is held until the shale settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the signal audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 26% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. A farm running 49 keys thus pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation low-cost. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
